message.content: {"action":"decrease_precision","reason":"The symmetric_preadd structure at coef_frac=15 already achieves the same SQNR (85.14 dB) as direct with substantially lower area (8520 vs 12783 um^2), so the architecture is settled. Decreasing coefficient fractional precision is the only legal action that can reduce mapped area further; the resulting SQNR loss can be assessed against the current 85.14 dB baseline."}
